$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2\,⟹\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\text{d}u.
$$

Using the above, we can write the integral in terms of $u$ and evaluate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 2\csc(2 x)\cot(2 x)\,\text{d}x & =\int 2\csc(u)\cot(u)\cdot \frac{1}{2}\,\text{d}u \\ & =\int \csc(u)\cot(u)\,\text{d}u \\ & =-\csc(u)+C \\ & =C - \csc{\left(2 x \right)}\end{aligned}
$$
